Traditional hand-painted fantasy CRPG portrait aesthetic, realistic textured brushwork, rich restrained palette, soft warm key light and muted dark charcoal atmospheric background. Face large and readable as a small party icon, full top of head including horns within frame, shoulders visible, breathing room above head. All characters adults with individual faces and varied adult ages; fantasy anatomy must clearly communicate the species. Practical class clothing, no sexualized poses. Single individual only; no collage, panels, borders, text, watermark, logos or existing copyrighted characters. Original independently designed artwork, not derived from the screenshot or original game assets.
Subject: Orc with a strong broad jaw, visible lower tusks, pronounced brows and olive green skin; dignified nuanced person; non-binary adult (gender is catalog metadata, not an anatomical stereotype), individual gender expression and natural presentation. Appearance: Distinctive natural variation appropriate to this fantasy species. Class: cleric; chainmail and a modest ivory tabard, a small original abstract holy emblem, compassionate resolve. Distinct individual variation seed: 1011; use this only to vary age, hairstyle, face, pose and costume detail, never render numbers.
Individual art direction: older adult, about 65 with visible natural age lines; near frontal view, calm thoughtful expression. hair swept back simply without braids. Keep the established painted finish and large readable face.
